title: Checks for uses of the builtin eval() function.
summary: The eval() function is insecure as it enables arbitrary code execution. Ruff takes this rule from pygrep-hooks, and removed it.

title: Check for usages of the deprecated warn method from the logging module.
summary: The warn method is deprecated. Use warning instead. Ruff takes this rule from pygrep-hooks, and removed it.

title: Check for type: ignore annotations that suppress all type warnings, as opposed to targeting specific type warnings.
summary: Suppressing all warnings can hide issues in the code. Ruff takes this rule from pygrep-hooks and made it stable in v0.0.187.
message_templates: Use specific rule codes when ignoring type issues

title: Check for noqa annotations that suppress all diagnostics, as opposed to targeting specific diagnostics.
summary: Suppressing all diagnostics can hide issues in the code. Ruff takes this rule from pygrep-hooks and made it stable in v0.0.200.
message_templates: Use specific rule codes when using `noqa`
Use specific rule codes when using `ruff: noqa`
Use a colon when specifying `noqa` rule codes

title: Checks for common mistakes when using mock objects.
summary: The mock module exposes an assertion API that can be used to verify that mock objects undergo expected interactions. This rule checks for common mistakes when using this API. Ruff takes this rule from pygrep-hooks and made it stable in v0.0.266.
